declaration.title: Selected Dataform file has no detected secrets
declaration.remediation: Remove credentials from the selected Dataform file and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in the explicitly selected Dataform file.
The value is hidden; detection did not validate the credential.

selection.named_only: engine-derived _content_secret_scan_kinds must include dataform_selected_file only for the exact explicitly named check ID
selection.workspace_revision: Optional revision key must be a lowercase 40-hex Git SHA; symbolic revisions are rejected. Without it, evidence is observed_workspace with timestamp and no immutable claim.
selection.scope: Exact requested project scope and repository parent; explicit paths only, no directory queries, list calls or pagination.
selection.disabled_or_unselected: Zero content calls, credential acquisition, sessions or detector invocations.

native_proof.project: Exactly one complete CRM v3 project, numeric name=projects/{number}, projectId, and selected scope matching its ID or number. No invented projectNumber field.
native_proof.repository: Native GET /v1/{repository}?fields=name,gitRemoteSettings(url), exact returned name. Repository readFile rejected if gitRemoteSettings.url is nonempty. Workspace reading may use remote-backed repositories through the native workspace endpoint only.
native_proof.workspace: Native GET /v1/{workspace}?fields=name, exact returned name and validated repository parent.
native_proof.workspace_file: Native GET /v1/{workspace}:readFile?path=... and optional revision=40hex; fileContents base64 field.
native_proof.response_identity_limit: Neither file response returns resource name, path or revision. Binding relies on exact validated HTTPS request and exact native parent GET names, not fabricated response echo fields or a local Git object verification.

privacy.acquisition: Dedicated streaming requests.Session with trust_env=False, auth=None, cookies cleared, fixed dataform.googleapis.com HTTPS, redirects disabled, exact prepared response URL, no response history/auth challenge/encoding/range. Bounded raw read before JSON/base64/UTF8 parsing; Transport.request JSON cache never sees file or metadata bytes.
privacy.diagnostics: Fail closed before credentials if urllib3.connectionpool DEBUG logging or http.client HTTP debug output is enabled; never change global logger settings.
privacy.output: SHA256 of selector creates opaque resource ID; no raw file/repository/workspace names, request URLs, bodies, credentials, errors, snippets or reversible content hashes. File values are not written to disk.
privacy.detectors: Kingfisher SDK 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5 via shared scan_content; detection only, no verification/update/archive expansion. Constant scanner source path prevents a secret-bearing selected filename entering redacted scan cache.
privacy.dedup: Shared process-HMAC fingerprints and merge_leaks; normal secret_findings dedup yields one hidden leak across both engines, both Dataform APIs and other services.
privacy.provenance: Every successful or failed read attempt emits only constant operation, scope, opaque selector ID, status, safe static reason, counts and HTTP status. All per-target request IDs are linked from marker, field coverage, item provenance, collection envelope and final snapshot metadata.

limit_semantics.bytes: MAX_TOTAL_BYTES counts wire bytes including metadata and JSON/base64 overhead. Each file decoded size is independently bounded. No compressed or archive extraction.
limit_semantics.pages: No list/directory/page API calls; exactly 2 calls per repository file or 3 per workspace file. Native max_pages applies only to paginated supporting inventories, not these unpaged GETs; calls and files are bounded independently. Native resource limits may reduce collection coverage to UNKNOWN.
limit_semantics.time: Shared per-Transport monotonic budget across selected files/scopes plus native cancellation/call/deadline limits. Deadline checked before/after every raw read; real socket read timeout tightened to remaining budget; both detector timeouts capped to half remaining time.

verdicts.PASS: Only the complete exact selected UTF8 text file observation, with both pinned engines complete, valid native identity and linked read receipts, has no supported detected secret. No repository/workspace/history-wide absence claim.
verdicts.FAIL: Complete selected read with both pinned detectors complete and one or more redacted supported indicators; credential validity is never assessed.
verdicts.UNKNOWN: Disabled/missing selection, unsupported revision/remote repository, missing/denied parents, foreign identity, redirect/challenge, missing Content-Length, truncated/overlong/oversize streams, duplicate/malformed JSON, wrong response field, missing content field, noncanonical base64, invalid UTF8/binary, deadline/cancellation, unavailable tools or finding bounds. Partial positives never become a clean verdict.

coverage_inventory.surface: Dataform native local repository selected file at commit SHA
Dataform native workspace selected file at explicit SHA or observed current contents
Whole repository/workspace enumeration, Git history, remote Git fallback, managed Secret Manager values
coverage_inventory.reason: Outside exact selected-file authority and bounds; no whole-repository negative is implied.
Separate bounded read-only Git protocol follow-up; discovery exposes metadata, not readFile.

root_delivery.remaining: Root integrates intake validation/named planner kind, native inventory job/support/dependency/default exclusion, registry/canonical copy/fixture/group admission and any desired shared host allowlist declaration. Dedicated reader itself accepts only dataform.googleapis.com and requires no normal transport content hook.

validation.source_cases: Full indexes and snapshots produced through actual native GCPCollector compiled with the precise proposed dependent job hook, mocked native HTTPS responses, actual installed pinned detectors.
validation.patch_validation: git apply --check succeeded against current shared files; no shared changes applied

legacy_csr_followup.native_metadata: GET https://sourcerepo.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/repos/REPO, exact name and native read-only url; independently bind CRM project. Repo names may contain slashes; reject traversal/encoding ambiguity. Inspect url only to confirm the derived fixed Google clone endpoint, never follow arbitrary mirrorConfig URLs.
read_only_protocol: POST fixed base + /git-upload-pack using Git pkt-line wants for an explicitly selected immutable commit; this fetch negotiation is read-only and is distinct from mutating git-receive-pack.
legacy_csr_followup.proof: Validate requested commit object, tree walk and selected blob hashes/lengths from a bounded verified pack; never infer whole-history absence. Server may reject an unadvertised SHA; remain UNKNOWN instead of fetching arbitrary refs.
legacy_csr_followup.auth: Use only explicitly supplied approved native CSR read credentials on exact source.developers.google.com, read-only OAuth scope where supported. Google documents gcloud/manual Git auth; exact noninteractive token exchange must be independently verified and tested before admission. Do not invoke ambient Git credential helpers, SSH, executable configs, OAuth realm redirects or auth generation.
legacy_csr_followup.required_bounds: Dedicated transient no-redirect/no-proxy HTTP, explicit repository+commit+file selectors, compressed/expanded pack and delta/object/depth/path/file/call/time caps, object IDs verified, redacted receipt provenance, cancellation and real dual-tool tests. No checkout, filesystem writes of blobs, hooks, submodules, LFS, archives, external Git hosts, push/receive-pack or cloud mutation.
